issues.reason: "key" is a descriptive (non-classifying) modifier on a plural, which the instruction set requires to be asserted of the members through the distributive rule over (PartOf $x <group>) — it may be neither fused into the kind nor predicated of the group symbol, but dropping it omits content the rule licenses.

"Other" is a contrastive determiner relating the members to a discourse set, not a property predicable of an individual, and it has no licensed carrier (the reviewer's own gap); the instruction set forbids inventing an encoding to fill a gap, so leaving it out is the correct behaviour.

The anaphoric link is genuinely unrecorded — that half stands — but this is not a parse defect: the antecedent was rendered as the bare kind constant pakistani_city, so no entity symbol exists to reuse (the reviewer's own registered gap), and (GroupOf sk_areas_1 area) is itself neither false nor ill-typed.
